_tuning_notes: Thresholds tuned on real CSV distributions (JKUAT station, Kiambu Kenya, 2026-08-28..2026-09-15, 1-min sampling, ~21k rows across 3 windows): temp_sht 11.8-29.5C, humidity_sht 30-95%, wind_gust up to 15.8 m/s (average wind speed only 0-3 m/s), 0.4 mm total rainfall over 10 days (dry season). Dry-season rules therefore fire steadily on this dataset. heat_idx / wet_bulb fields correlate strongly with temp_sht and are not scored separately. Rain rules use rg1+rg2 tipping-bucket sums; the wind rule uses gusts because average wind speed is insensitive at this site.

rules.description: Low cumulative rainfall over the past 72 hours (persistent dry conditions)

recommendations.residents: Review non-essential water use and consider safe water storage
recommendations.farmers: Review irrigation schedules and actual soil moisture; follow local agricultural guidance
recommendations.managers: Watch the dry trend and consider a community water-saving reminder

rules.description: Few rainy days in the last 7 days (rolling rainfall below the recent local baseline)

recommendations.residents: Keep an eye on storage levels and avoid water waste
recommendations.farmers: Assess upcoming irrigation needs and avoid watering at midday heat
recommendations.managers: Check the status of community water sources and storage facilities

rules.description: High temperature combined with low humidity (strong evaporative conditions)

recommendations.residents: Shift outdoor watering to early morning or evening
recommendations.farmers: Irrigate early or late and mulch soil to reduce evaporation
recommendations.managers: Remind residents to schedule water use around peak heat

rules.description: High temperature recorded in the past 24 hours

recommendations.residents: Cut non-essential water use during peak heat
recommendations.farmers: Watch the drinking-water needs of crops and livestock
recommendations.managers: Monitor water-supply load during hot periods

rules.description: Strong wind gusts combined with high temperature (increased evaporation exposure)

recommendations.residents: Cover open water containers to limit evaporation and dust
recommendations.farmers: Avoid spray irrigation during hot, windy periods
recommendations.managers: Check storage facilities for wind-related losses

rules.description: Sudden rainfall increase in the past hour (standalone storage/drainage heads-up; not counted in the stress score)

recommendations.residents: Check rooftop collection and storage containers and get ready to harvest rain
recommendations.farmers: Check field drainage to avoid short-term waterlogging
recommendations.managers: Check drainage channels and storage; alert the community about short intense rain

Low.residents: Water-stress risk is currently low; keep your normal water habits
Low.farmers: Follow your usual irrigation plan and watch upcoming weather
Low.managers: No extra action needed; keep monitoring

Medium.residents: Start saving water and confirm storage is sufficient
Medium.farmers: Optimize irrigation timing and prioritize key crops
Medium.managers: Consider a community water-saving notice and check storage facilities

High.residents: Save water now and prepare storage; follow updates from local authorities
High.farmers: Pause non-critical irrigation; secure drinking water and key crops first
High.managers: Issue a community alert and prioritize supply and storage checks
